City of Arlington in a court of competent jurisdiction, and this remedy shall be in addition
to any penal provision in this ordinance or in the Code of the City of Arlington.
This ordinance shall become effective from and after its passage upon signature of
the Mayor.
PRESENTED AND GIVEN FIRST READING on the 1Oth day of

ordinance, acting for the City of Arlington in the discharge of his/her duties, shall not
thereby render himself/herself personally liable; and he/she is hereby relieved from all
personal liability for any damage that might accrue to persons or property as a result of
any act required or permitted in the discharge of his/her said duties.
Any violation of this ordinance can be enjoined by a suit filed in the name of the
City of Arlington in a court of competent jurisdiction, and this remedy shall be in addition
to any penal provision in this ordinance or in the Code of the City of Arlington.
This ordinance shall become effective from and after its passage upon signature of
the Mayor.
PRESENTED AND GIVEN FIRST READING on the 7th day of August
2018, at a regular meeting of the City Council of the City of Arlington, Texas; and
GIVEN SECOND READING, passed and approved on the 20th day of
August , 2018, by a vote of 9 ayes and O nays at a regular meeting
of the City Council of the City of Arlington, Texas.
